title: AIGame Preset
description: A .preset.json file. Controls sampling and how the prompt is assembled. Editable in both the creator and the game.

sampling.description: Omitted values are not sent, so the provider default applies.

summarize_after_turns.description: Turns older than this are folded into the running summary. 0 disables.

prompts.description: Replacements for the game's own wording, by name: how the rules are explained to the story model (narrator_mechanics, narrator_prose, narrator_records, leaving_prose, leaving_records) and the whole prompt of each helper job (resolve_actions, record_changes, judge_quests, direct_scene, suggest_choices, summarize). Leave one out to use the game's own. The defaults, and which {{parts}} the game fills in for each, are in game/aigame/wording.py; the creator's preset builder shows them. A part left out of a replacement is added at its end.

blocks.description: Prompt is built top to bottom from enabled blocks, with one rule that overrides the order: the slots that change during play (summary, lorebook, state, quests) are always sent with the newest message, after the history. That keeps the start of the prompt identical from turn to turn, which is what lets providers cache it. Text blocks placed below the history slot are sent after the player's newest message, as the very last thing the model reads, every turn.

name.description: Label shown next to the toggle.

help.description: One-line explanation shown in simple mode.

kind.description: text: author-written content. slot: filled by the engine from the card and save.

slot.description: For slot blocks. action_protocol is required for game mechanics and cannot be disabled.

simple.description: Show this toggle in simple mode.
